jobs.description: Overview CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day. At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you. Responsibilities Business Development Manager, Global Portable Snacking The Opportunity in Plano, Texas PepsiCo is building the next wave of growth in portable snacking, bringing together global brands, advantaged formats, and new ways to reach consumers across markets and channels. As part of PepsiCo’s Global Imports & Portable Snacking business, you’ll help shape and scale a high-priority growth platform with an ambition to reach $3–4B in business by 2030, while building a sustainable, high-margin model across markets. In this role, you’ll connect strategy with execution—identifying where the biggest opportunities exist, shaping market and portfolio priorities, and working with teams across the business to turn those opportunities into actionable plans. You’ll partner closely with Strategy, Marketing, Commercial, Supply Chain, Operations, and local market teams to determine where PepsiCo should play, how we should win, and what capabilities and investments are needed to accelerate growth. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex business questions, working across functions and markets, and turning insights into decisions that have a tangible impact on a growing global business. What You’ll Do Shape the long-term opportunity: Partner with Strategy to define the growth opportunity for portable snacking, including market potential, key growth drivers, and priorities across geographies. Turn strategy into action: Translate long-term ambitions into clear priorities, decisions, and actions that can be incorporated into near-term business plans. Identify growth opportunities: Analyze market dynamics, competitive trends, consumer insights, and business performance to identify priority markets and whitespace opportunities. Shape the portfolio strategy: Work with Marketing and cross-functional partners to define the future role of portable snacking formats—including Stax, Minis, and Square Canisters—and how they can drive growth across different markets. Build market and investment plans: Partner with local teams to develop market-level plans, including format priorities, launch sequencing, and investment opportunities. Build fact-based business cases to help prioritize resources. Scale opportunities globally: Connect markets to identify transferable opportunities, best practices, and synergies that can accelerate growth across the portfolio. Lead strategic initiatives: Drive or support high-impact, cross-functional projects that strengthen the business model, value chain, and future growth opportunities. Influence senior stakeholders: Bring a strategic point of view to leadership discussions, highlighting opportunities, gaps, trade-offs, and areas requiring deeper analysis. Qualifications What We’re Looking For Approximately 5 years of experience in strategy, business development, management consulting, or a related strategic role; global or multi-market experience is a plus. Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex or ambiguous business questions and translate them into actionable recommendations. Commercial acumen and the ability to connect market opportunities, portfolio decisions, operations, and financial considerations. Experience working across functions and influencing stakeholders without direct authority. Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data, market insights, and business cases to support strategic decisions. Ability to bring an external perspective, challenge conventional thinking, and identify new approaches to growth. Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information for senior audiences. Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities evolve and solutions are not always clearly defined. Why PepsiCo You’ll join a global team working on a high-priority growth platform from the ground up, with the opportunity to influence strategy across markets while staying close to execution. This role offers exposure to senior leaders and cross-functional teams across Strategy, Marketing, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Operations, while giving you the opportunity to help shape how PepsiCo builds and scales new sources of growth globally. Compensation & Benefits The expected salary range for this position is USD $125,363–$155,185. Actual starting salary will be determined based on location, job-related skills, experience, education, and other relevant factors. Eligible employees may receive an annual performance-based bonus with a 12% target payout. PepsiCo offers a comprehensive benefits package, subject to eligibility and elections, including medical, dental, vision, disability coverage, health and dependent care reimbursement accounts, employee assistance programs, insurance benefits, paid time off, paid parental leave, and a defined contribution retirement plan. We are looking for an experienced Sr. Manager of Crewing to serve as the centralized crewing authority across all of our live sports properties. The Production Operations team is responsible for delivering high-quality event and studio productions on all global live sports properties to customers worldwide, across all Prime Video product lines and devices. We drive production excellence through streamlined processes and operational frameworks that empower the team to work more efficiently and grow with increasing demand. The growing volume and complexity across our properties demands a dedicated Sr. Manager of Crewing. This role provides the centralized coordination layer to ensure consistency, resolve conflicts, and maintain a unified view of crew availability across the entire Prime Video Live Sports portfolio and with third-party vendors. Our crewing operation is purpose-built around the needs of an expanding, multi-sport live portfolio rather than modeled after a traditional broadcast network structure. We are defining and building as we evolve, and this person must be excited to roll up their sleeves and help establish the systems, relationships, and workflows that will scale with us. This role requires deep knowledge of remote, event, and studio production crewing, including broadcast positions, industry standard rates, and an established network of relationships across production services. The Sr. Manager of Crewing will work in lockstep with property leads to ensure each event or studio show is properly staffed, communicating proactively with third-party partners to prevent gaps, resolve conflicts in real time, and keep productions on track. This role will also work closely with Amazon's internal legal and labor teams to ensure compliance with all applicable workforce regulations. The Sr. Manager of Crewing will be responsible for escalating issues that require senior leadership attention, keeping the Global Head of Production Operations informed on matters that carry risk or require resolution. Additionally, this person will partner directly with our Production Service Providers (PSP) to establish best practices, define operational standards for how PSPs engage with our productions, and ensure alignment on processes and expectations across the vendor landscape. The successful candidate is a self-starter who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment. You possess the ability to manage high volumes of tasks and projects quickly with autonomy, react with urgency to situations that demand immediate attention, and have a proven track record of end-to-end ownership in a fast-paced, dynamic business environment. Key job responsibilities • Cross-Property Crew Coordination & Visibility: Serve as the centralized coordination point across all live sports properties and studio productions, maintaining real-time visibility into crew availability, deployment, and engagement history to prevent scheduling conflicts. Work in lockstep with property leads to ensure every event and programming block is fully staffed with preferred, best-in-class personnel aligned to creative and editorial vision. • Real-Time Conflict Resolution: Identify and resolve crew conflicts in real time across overlapping productions, proactively scanning the production calendar to flag scheduling gaps and crewing risks well in advance of air. Coordinate with property leads to develop contingency plans and maintain a bench of qualified alternatives. • Rate Structure & Cost Consistency: Maintain organized, transparent rate structures across properties and personnel tiers, partnering with Production Ops and Production Managers leads to ensure alignment and consistency across comparable roles and production formats. Analyze crew spend patterns and maintain market-competitive positioning. Coordinate fee reconciliation and payment processing with third-party vendors across multiple properties to ensure accuracy and timeliness. Serve as a resource for property Production Operations and Production Management leads on market benchmarks and crew compensation norms to support informed planning decisions. • 3P Labor & Workforce Compliance: Serve as the primary point of contact for third-party labor questions. Navigate both union and non-union production environments, and ensure third-party PSPs adhere to all applicable labor regulations and collective bargaining agreements. Work closely with Amazon's internal legal and labor teams to stay current on regulatory requirements, labor guidelines, and workforce compliance standards across domestic and international markets. Advise property leads on compliance considerations as they arise, including crew classification, jurisdictional rules, and engagement terms. • Crew Scheduling & Resource Management: Ensure crew and resource scheduling across remote, studio, and third-party vendor operations stays aligned with property needs. Establish clear parameters and consistent frameworks for how personnel are deployed across productions. Recruit, negotiate, and onboard key Above-The-Line (ATL) and Below-The-Line (BTL) positions through PSPs as needed, establishing deal and rate frameworks, and engagement standards that apply uniformly across all properties. Maintain a centralized personnel repository, with the willingness to step in and coordinate travel and deployment logistics as production needs arise. • Systems, Tools & Reporting: Own and leverage internal production management tools to maintain full visibility into all productions and crew assignments, implementing and refining systems that map personnel to events, track availability, and surface conflicts. When needed, prepare and distribute crew communications (call sheets, playbooks, and pertinent production information) to stakeholders, and report on crewing metrics and workforce utilization to senior leadership.

Corporate: Engage in a deep variety of business-critical activities that keep our company running efficiently. From strategic marketing and financial management to human resources and operational oversight, you’ll have the opportunity to optimize processes and implement game-changing policies.

Position Purpose: Produce sharp, accurate, on-brand written content that turns StoneX's market expertise and studio output into engaging stories across our channels.

The work spans editing and original writing, with the support and direction of a close-knit content team. Technology Ecosystem:

LLM and AI writing tools with prompt workflows (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT), WordPress / Sitecore, HubSpot, Google Analytics 4, SEMrush / Ahrefs, Grammarly Business, Microsoft 365, Adobe Creative Suite, Jira / Confluence, and basic HTML.

Primary duties will include:

• Write and edit crisp, platform-specific copy from studio video output and market developments, across YouTube, social, articles, and white-paper drafts, with quick turnaround.
• Use AI writing tools fluently to accelerate your work, then shape everything into accurate, on-brand copy.
• Handle on-page basics: metadata, titles, tags, and CTAs.
• Publish and maintain content within the company CMS, keeping links, visuals, and accessibility in order.
• Follow the style guide to keep everything on-brand, accurate, and compliant.
• Work closely with the wider content and marketing team, taking direction on messaging, channels, and timing.

Qualifications

• A demonstrable 3+ years' track record of editing and writing for digital channels, with a portfolio showing both polished long-form and sharp short-form work. We care about what you can do, not how many years it took to get there.
• Real, hands-on fluency with AI writing tools and prompting. You already use them daily and understand their failure modes.

• Comfortable working in modern CMS platforms (e.g. Drupal, WordPress, Sitecore) and basic HTML.
• Solid editorial standards across grammar and accuracy, plus awareness of compliance requirements in regulated industries.
• Comfortable partnering with multimedia teams (video, design) to produce cohesive content.

• Background in trading, asset management, or markets and personal-finance journalism.
• Experience building or automating content workflows (prompt libraries, templates, light scripting, or no-code automation).

About the Team

OpenAI’s Infrastructure organization builds and evaluates the systems that power advanced AI workloads. We work closely with hardware, modeling, and architecture teams to ensure that new platforms deliver real-world performance aligned with workload needs.

Our team focuses on understanding workload behavior across evolving hardware platforms—bridging the gap between theoretical capability and observed system performance.

About the Role

We are seeking a Workload Porting & Performance Engineer to evaluate new hardware platforms by porting benchmarks and real-world workloads, analyzing performance, and identifying system bottlenecks.

In this role, you will bring up workloads on new systems, characterize performance behavior, and adapt workloads to better utilize hardware capabilities. You will play a critical role in validating new platforms and ensuring that performance aligns with expectations across compute, memory, and networking subsystems.

This role requires strong hands-on experience with performance analysis, workload optimization, and system-level debugging across hardware and software boundaries.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance.

Key Responsibilities

- Port and enable benchmarks and real-world workloads on new hardware platforms.

- Evaluate system performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking subsystems.

- Identify and analyze performance bottlenecks and inefficiencies.

- Adapt and optimize workloads to better utilize hardware capabilities.

- Develop and run performance experiments and profiling workflows.

- Compare expected vs. observed performance and provide feedback to:

- hardware architecture teams

- performance modeling teams

- system and software engineers.

- Debug issues across the stack, including software, runtime, and hardware interactions.

- Provide actionable insights to guide platform readiness and deployment decisions.

Qualifications

- Experience with performance analysis, benchmarking, or workload optimization.

- Strong understanding of system architecture, including CPU/GPU, memory, and I/O subsystems.

- Experience porting or adapting workloads across different hardware platforms.

- Familiarity with profiling tools and performance debugging techniques.

- Ability to identify root causes of performance issues across hardware/software boundaries.

- Experience working in large-scale or distributed system environments.

Preferred Skills

- Experience with AI/ML workloads, including training or inference systems.

- Familiarity with GPU or accelerator-based systems.

- Experience working with low-level performance tools (profilers, tracing, microbenchmarks).

- Background in systems software, compilers, or runtime optimization.

- Experience collaborating with hardware and architecture teams on performance validation.

About OpenAI

회사소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는
